task_name: Server-side filter controls, state reset, summary, sorting, paging, and list retry

concerns_addressed: Cycle-1 Critical (sentinel returned 0 rows) RESOLVED: ProductController.php:190-194 intercepts '__none__' with whereNull('category') OR TRIM(category)='' instead of literal match; frontend api.ts NO_CATEGORY_FILTER='__none__' sends category=__none__ (page.tsx:224-231, api.ts:223,303) and backend test test_no_category_sentinel_filters_null_and_empty_categories_with_other_filters asserts null + whitespace-only rows match with AND semantics and include_unpurchasable=1.

Cycle-1 Critical (binary category sort) RESOLVED: resolveCategories now sorts with strcasecmp (ProductController.php:117), test expectation updated to ['Alpha','beta','Sembako','Zebra'], matching frontend localeCompare sensitivity 'base' (api.ts:129,164). The T1/T3 category-sort case-insensitivity Minor is therefore resolved and dropped, not re-emitted.

strengths: Tanpa kategori works end-to-end: frontend sends category=__none__ and backend matches only null/empty/whitespace-only via whereNull OR TRIM(category)='', never literal '__none__' (points a,b).
Ordinary category filter stays exact-after-trim and case-sensitive (whereRaw TRIM(category)=?, no LOWER), so 'Minuman' matches 'Minuman'/'  Minuman  ' but not 'minuman'/'Minuman Ringan' (point c).

Filters are server-side with AND semantics for category+status+stock_health; include_unpurchasable=1 passes through and skips only supplier eligibility; legacy path without the flag unchanged (points d,e).
Filter change resets cursor to 0, preserves selected sort/order via sortRef, closes all expanded rows, and summary/has_more come from the filtered response meta (points f,g,h,i).
Retryable list error with keyboard-accessible native Button 'Coba lagi', disabled + guard while loading so no duplicate requests (point j).
AbortController per list load with abort-on-new-load and abort-on-unmount, aborted-signal early returns, and loading cleared only by the current controller; stale responses cannot paint (point k).
Category metadata distinct, non-empty, trimmed, case-insensitively sorted (strcasecmp) matching frontend base-sensitivity ordering (point l).

No changes to Table.tsx, no database migration, no order/inventory deduction or public-catalog eligibility changes; OutletDrawer/T8 files in range noted as out-of-scope parallel-plan changes and not charged to T4 (point m).

Refactor heuristics checked and cleared: no identical logic 3+ times in scope; page.tsx (320 lines, component 292) and api.ts (375) sit within sibling admin-page convention (drivers 462, outlets 374, promotions 307); splitting the page component would add out-of-scope abstractions.
